name: Fix the Bug (Hard)
description: The frontier variant of Fix the Bug, on the same tools and sandbox. Three larger repositories (23-25 files, 800+ lines each: a payroll engine, a multi-currency ledger with async storage, a help-centre search engine with BM25 ranking) full of plausible distractors: deprecated modules marked do-not-fix, TODO comments that look like bugs but are not, and tests that look flaky but are correct. Each repo has three bugs. The first is visible but its failing test points at the wrong module; the second only shows up after the first is fixed; the third is caught ONLY by the hidden tests, so the model must read the README spec carefully and check the code against it, not just make the visible tests green. The bug report describes symptoms, not causes. 35 actions and 250,000 output tokens, not enough to read everything.
hook: Green visible tests are not enough: one bug per repo is only caught by the hidden tests, and the failing test points at the wrong file.
author: Gauntlet Core
